source_title: AI Demand Drives Rapid Growth in QLC Enterprise SSD Shipments for 2024, Says TrendForce
claim_relevant_visible_text: QLC enterprise SSD bits to reach 30 exabytes in 2024—increasing fourfold in volume from 2023.
researcher_paraphrase: TrendForce forecast 2024 QLC enterprise SSD bit shipments at 30 EB, roughly four times 2023 volume.
precision_guard: This is a contemporaneous April 2024 market forecast for full-year 2024 QLC enterprise SSD bit shipments. It is not a realized 2024 Outcome and must remain a Judgment vintage until comparable later measurement is recovered.
authority_boundary: TrendForce is methodological-primary for its own market estimate/forecast and methodology, not a primary supplier shipment ledger.
